_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX LiveRates master 744:7619. Same tolerances as buttons / dialogs / cards. Real SVG icons are shipped (LiveRatesIcons.tsx) so icon-diff should find vector-path-set parity — no font-glyph waivers needed.
_tolerancesNote: x/y/w/h tolerances widened to 2 px (matching the toast master's config) to absorb the 1-2 px discrepancy between figma's auto-layout source dimensions and the rasterised content area when the master draws a 1 px stroke (figma reports child widths from the pre-stroke auto-layout target — impl content area is reduced by border-box stroke).
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels the CJK family 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; the app ships HarmonyOS Sans SC + PlusJakartaSans-* for Latin. These aliases keep the diff free of phantom font deviations.
_ignoreTextNote: Empty by design — diff.mjs does NOT compare text content directly (only box/typography), so the seed-data mismatch between figma's 'USD/CNY × 10' and the impl's mockRates pairs doesn't surface as a finding. Filtering them via ignoreText would orphan the impl figmaIds as EXTRA, since the diff drops filtered figma nodes from the pairing pass.
